name: Sparkline
description: A tiny SVG trend line that draws itself in, fills a fading gradient area and lands on a pulsing end dot. Hover or arrow keys scrub a cursor with a live value readout, shown as a KPI card or a bare inline chip.
a11yNotes: The chart is one focusable role="img" whose aria-label summarizes the series (point count, first/last, low/high). Left/Right arrows, Home and End move a cursor through the points and a polite live region announces "Point n: value"; Escape and blur reset it. Focus is shown with a 2px outline. Under prefers-reduced-motion the line, area and end dot render immediately and the pulse loop is disabled.

propsApi.name: values
propsApi.description: Data points; numeric strings and comma separated strings are parsed, invalid entries are skipped.

propsApi.name: label
propsApi.description: Metric name shown in the card header and used in the accessible summary.

propsApi.name: variant
propsApi.description: KPI card with a big readout and trend delta, or just the line with a small readout chip.

propsApi.name: curve
propsApi.description: Catmull-Rom smoothed curve or straight segments.

propsApi.name: showArea
propsApi.description: Fill the area under the line with a fading gradient.

propsApi.name: showDot
propsApi.description: Show a pulsing dot on the last point.

propsApi.name: width
propsApi.description: Chart width in px (shrinks to fit narrow containers).

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
